notes.title: The Minor Scale OST is now live on streaming services!
Small Release Patch
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue that caused some notes to go under the rhythm board
    [*]Fixed an issue that caused baby spiders to get stuck in level 2
    [*]Temporarily removed achievements that were inaccessible through gameplay
    [*]Added more critters to the avatar selection menu
[/list]

We have more updates and patches on the way. Thank you for playing!
